Investor Relations investor.relations@wnco.com SOUTHWEST AIRLINES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS; RECORD REVENUE PERFORMANCE DRIVES YEAR-OVER-YEAR MARGIN EXPANSION Record third quarter operating revenue and all-time record unit revenues Expanded margins year-over-year despite significant fuel headwind Announced Southwest Icon Lounge™ network Will host a Capital Markets Day in New York City on March 2, 2027 DALLAS, TEXAS - October 21, 2026 - Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE: LUV) today reported third quarter 2026 financial results, reflecting strong demand for the Southwest product and continued momentum across the business. "Customers are responding to the enhanced Southwest offering, and it shows in our results. Demand remained strong as we lapped last year's bag fee and other commercial initiatives, reinforcing our belief that the earnings power we've built is durable, even with significantly higher fuel costs. "With the transformation complete, our efforts have shifted to optimizing the business and delivering the next set of Customer Experience enhancements, both focused on unlocking the next phase of value creation. Robust demand has continued in the fourth quarter, and we are seeing encouraging progress across our product and loyalty initiatives. We remain confident in our ability to further strengthen earnings, improve returns, and expand margins over time. "We look forward to sharing our multi-year financial framework, the targets we are managing toward, and our path to achieving them at our Capital Markets Day in New York City on March 2, 2027," said Bob Jordan, Southwest Airlines President & Chief Executive Officer. 1 Highlights: • Net income of $270 million, or $0.55 diluted EPS, adjusted net income¹ of $328 million, or $0.66 adjusted EPS¹ • Operating revenues of $8.4 billion, up 21.2%, a third quarter Company record • Unit revenues increased 21.6%, exceeding prior guidance, achieving an all-time record • Operating margin of 4.5%, up 4.0 points year-over-year; adjusted operating margin¹ of 5.4%, up 4.8 points year-over-year despite an $821 million increase in nominal fuel costs • Returned $176 million to Shareholders through dividends • Record third quarter passenger revenue and the highest passenger yield in the Company's history • Managed business revenue reached a third quarter record, with 20 of the 50 all-time top managed business booking days occurring during the quarter • Announced enhancements to the Rapid Rewards® program, including a new Platinum tier, a faster path to status through card spend, new Milestone Rewards, and new loyalty redemption partners • Announced plans to launch the Southwest Icon Lounge™ network, the Company's first airport lounges, with the first guests expected in 2027 • Became the first U.S. airline to make flight shopping available through ChatGPT • Enhanced Southwest Business with the introduction of Business Priority and NDC connectivity, making it easier for corporate Customers to access and book Southwest products and services • Welcomed TAP Air Portugal and LOT Polish Airlines as Southwest's tenth and eleventh airline partners • Continued installation of Starlink ultra-fast WiFi across all aircraft, with fleet-wide installation expected to be complete in fall 2027 2 Guidance and Outlook: The following tables provide guidance for fourth quarter and full-year 2026. The Company's guidance is based on the forward fuel curve as of October 15, 2026 and assumes the current fare environment and demand trends remain broadly intact. 4Q 2026 Forecast Adjusted EPS 1,2 $0.55 to $0.80 ASMs (a), year-over-year 3% to 4% RASM (b), year-over-year 19% to 21% CASM-X (c), year-over-year 1,2 4.0% to 4.5% 2026 Forecast Adjusted EPS 1,2 $2.60 to $2.85 (a) Available seat miles ("ASMs" or "capacity"). (b) Operating revenue per available seat mile ("RASM" or "unit revenues"). (c) Operating expenses per available seat mile, excluding aircraft fuel and related taxes expense, special items, and profit sharing ("CASM-X"). 3 Revenue: • Record third quarter 2026 operating revenues of $8.4 billion, up 21.2 percent year-over-year • Third quarter 2026 RASM reached an all-time record, increasing 21.6 percent year-over-year, on capacity down 0.4 percent • Fourth quarter 2026 RASM is expected to increase between 19% and 21% year-over-year Costs: • Third quarter 2026 operating expenses increased 16.3 percent year-over-year to $8.0 billion; operating expenses excluding special items¹ increased 15.4 percent year-over-year to $8.0 billion • Third quarter 2026 operating expenses, excluding aircraft fuel and related taxes expense, special items, and profit sharing 1 , increased 3.4 percent year-over-year • Third quarter 2026 CASM-X 1 increased 3.8 percent year-over-year • Fourth quarter 2026 CASM-X 1,2 is expected to increase between 4.0% and 4.5% year-over-year, which includes an expected 1.0 point headwind from the removal of six seats from the Boeing 737-700 fleet to enable extra legroom seating Fuel: • Third quarter 2026 fuel cost was $3.92 per gallon, above prior assumptions of $3.70 to $3.75 per gallon. Fuel expense increased by $821 million compared to the third quarter of 2025 and represented a $1.08 headwind to adjusted EPS • Fourth quarter 2026 fuel cost per gallon is assumed to be approximately $4.55 3 based on the forward curve as of October 15, 2026 Capacity, Fleet, and Capital Spending: • Third quarter 2026 capacity decreased 0.4 percent year-over-year • Received 20 Boeing 737-8 aircraft and retired 20 aircraft in third quarter 2026, ending the quarter with 803 aircraft (retirements included the sale of three Boeing 737-800 aircraft and the retirement of 17 Boeing 737-700 aircraft) • Third quarter 2026 gain on sale of $214 million, including $96 million primarily from retiring aircraft and engine sales and $118 million from sale-leaseback transactions • Third quarter 2026 gross capital expenditures were $1.0 billion, driven primarily by aircraft-related capital spending, as well as technology, facilities, and operational investments • Expect a total of 67 Boeing 737-8 and 737-7 aircraft deliveries and plan to retire approximately 60 aircraft in 2026 4 • Entered 2026 with a disciplined capacity plan and now expect full-year growth of approximately 1.2%, versus last updated guidance of approximately 1.5% • Expect 2026 net capital spending 4 between $2.5 billion and $2.75 billion Liquidity and Capital Deployment: • Ended third quarter 2026 with $5.6 billion in liquidity, comprised of $3.6 billion in cash and cash equivalents and a revolving credit line of $2.0 billion • Ended the quarter with gross leverage 1 of 1.9x • Have unencumbered aircraft and other related assets with a net book value of approximately $15.8 billion • Distributed $176 million in dividends during third quarter 2026 • $450 million remains outstanding under the Company's $2.0 billion share repurchase authorization 5 Conference Call: Southwest will discuss its third quarter 2026 results on a conference call at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on October 22, 2026. To listen to a live broadcast of the conference call, please go to https://www.investors.southwest.com . Footnotes 1 See Note Regarding Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures for additional information on special items. In addition, information regarding special items is included in the accompanying table Reconciliation of Reported Amounts to Non-GAAP Items (also referred to as "excluding special items"). 2 Projections do not reflect the potential impact of special items and/or Aircraft fuel and related taxes expense, special items, and profit sharing because the Company cannot reliably predict or estimate those items or expenses or their impact to its financial statements in future periods, particularly given the unusual or infrequent nature of special items and especially considering the significant volatility of the Aircraft fuel and related taxes expense line item. Accordingly, the Company believes a reconciliation of non-GAAP financial measures to the equivalent GAAP financial measures for these projected results is not meaningful or available without unreasonable effort. 3 Based on market prices as of October 15, 2026. Fuel cost per gallon includes fuel taxes and fuel hedging net premium expense of $0.05 per gallon related to terminated fuel derivative contracts. 4 Net capital expenditures include the impact of aircraft sales and sale-leaseback transactions. reference.summary: Southwest Airlines Co. operates as a passenger airline company that provides scheduled air transportation services in the United States and internationally. It also provides Rapid Rewards loyalty program; SWABIZ, an online booking tool; and inflight entertainment platform that includes movies-on-demand live and on-demand television, flight tracker, and additional curated content, as well as a variety of premium snacks and coffee. In addition, the company offers ancillary services, such as in-flight purchases, baggage fees, EarlyBird Check-In, and upgraded boarding, as well as transportation of pets and unaccompanied minors.
